name: Goi bon bon
summary: Gỏi bồn bồn is the bồn bồn salad in the sampler Vietnam Tourism’s dining page sets at a Can Tho table: salad, grilled duck skewer, shrimp in sugar cane, beef in betel leaf, and pork skewers.
origin: A Can Tho table in the Mekong dining chapter. The room is not a pick.
howToEat: At a table, at dinner, not on the wholesale boats.
where: Rooms along the Hậu. A restaurant name is not part of the plate.
seoTitle: Goi bon bon in Can Tho
seoDescription: Bồn bồn salad from the Can Tho sampler on Vietnam Tourism’s Mekong dining page.
